decoded.meaning: BATCH{ TIME u64=1700000000000000000, VALUE i32[2]={0,250}, VALUE[8]={FFFF0000, FF00FF00} } — a NON-UNIFORM packed batch (descriptor width = 4, dt_ns = 0): two offsets for n = 8 / 4 = 2 samples. A consumer that does not implement the packed block MUST treat this value as opaque (RFC-0025 §4.1.4, Amendment 5)
decoded.note: a width-unaware framed reader would see an offset run of 2 entries against 1 sample child and refuse; on a uniform stream it would instead read the whole block as ONE sample, which is the misreading the opaque rule exists to prevent. A node that stores or forwards the value moves these bytes unchanged either way
